scenarios.title: Registration controls and form sizing on desktop viewport
given: The user navigates to the Registration page on a desktop viewport
then: The webcam scan controls and manual identity form render with readable typography scaled appropriately to the page layout rather than inheriting oversized global site text
The webcam scan controls, input fields, and submission buttons are sized proportionally within their container without overflowing the screen

scenarios.title: Registration controls and form responsive layout on mobile viewport
given: The user navigates to the Registration page on a mobile viewport width
then: The webcam scan controls and manual identity form adapt to the narrow screen width without horizontal clipping or overflow
Typography, form inputs, and buttons remain legible, proportioned, and usable on mobile devices without inheriting oversized site typography

scenarios.title: Successful badge registration via webcam scan
given: The user is on the Registration page across either desktop or mobile viewport
The webcam scanner is active and ready
scenarios.when: A valid attendee badge code (e.g. 'BADGE101') is presented and scanned by the webcam
then: The scanned badge identifier is registered for the attendee
A success status message confirming the badge registration is displayed

scenarios.title: Unsuccessful badge registration from invalid webcam scan
given: The user is on the Registration page with an active webcam scanner
scenarios.when: An invalid or unassigned badge code (e.g. 'INVALID999') is scanned by the webcam
then: An error status message indicating the badge code is invalid or unrecognized is displayed

scenarios.title: Successful badge registration via manual ID entry
given: The user is on the Registration page across either desktop or mobile viewport
scenarios.when: The user enters the valid identifier into the manual identity form and submits the form
then: A success status message confirming the registration is displayed
The manual identity input is cleared or prepared for subsequent entry

scenarios.title: Manual registration with an unrecognized identity identifier
given: The user is on the Registration page
scenarios.when: The user inputs an unrecognized identity identifier (e.g. 'UNKNOWN000') into the manual identity form and submits
then: The badge registration request is rejected
An error status message indicating the identifier could not be verified is displayed

scenarios.title: Manual registration submission with missing identity input
given: The user is on the Registration page
scenarios.when: The user submits the manual identity form with an empty identifier field
then: The submission is prevented from registering a badge
A validation status message prompting the user to enter an identity identifier is displayed

scenarios.title: Status messages render legibly across desktop and mobile viewports
given: The user triggers a badge registration action on the Registration page
scenarios.when: A status message (e.g. success or error feedback) is rendered on the page
then: The status message text is fully visible within the layout bounds without horizontal overflow on both desktop and mobile viewports
The status message typography scales legibly alongside the responsive form controls

scenarios.title: Interactive usability of webcam controls and manual input on mobile
given: The user accesses the Registration page on a mobile device or narrow viewport
scenarios.when: The user interacts with the webcam controls and taps into the manual identity input field
then: Webcam scan controls respond immediately to user selection without layout displacement
The manual identity input field is focused and accessible for typing without breaking the responsive container layout
